column2: Our manager will negotiate a lower price with the supplier on Monday.
column3: 我們的經理星期一會與供應商協商較低的價格。
column5: 兩人坐在桌邊一來一往討價還價，把條件談妥

column2: The union's chief negotiator left the room to call her team.
column3: 工會的首席談判代表離開房間去打電話給她的團隊。
column5: negotiate 把 e 換成 or，就是負責談判的那個人

column2: The contractor promised to finish the new warehouse before winter.
column3: 承包商答應在冬天前完成新倉庫。
column5: contract 合約 + or 人，簽了合約來蓋房子的人

column2: Late delivery is a contractual issue, so please check the signed agreement.
column3: 延遲交貨屬於合約問題，所以請查看已簽署的協議。
column5: contract 合約 + ual 變形容詞，意思是合約上的

column2: Section four has a clause allowing either side to cancel with notice.
column3: 第四節有一項條款，允許任何一方通知後取消。
column5: clause 像 claws 爪子，一條條小條款抓住雙方

column2: A provision in the lease requires tenants to give sixty days' notice.
column3: 租約中的一項規定要求房客提前六十天通知。
column4: a provision in the contract (合約中的規定)
column5: pro 事先 + vision 看見，事先看到並寫進合約

column2: Both firms accepted the terms after two days of talks.
column3: 兩家公司在談了兩天後接受了條件。
column4: agree to the terms (同意條件)
column5: terms 要加 s 才是條件，一份合約有好多條

column2: Passing the safety inspection is a condition of the loan.
column3: 通過安全檢查是這筆貸款的先決條件。
column5: con 一起 + dit 說，雙方說好才成立的條件

column2: The job offer is conditional on a successful background check.
column3: 這份工作邀約以背景調查通過為條件。
column5: condition 加 al，後面常接 on，看條件才成立

column2: Once both parties sign, the agreement becomes legally binding.
column3: 雙方一簽字，協議就具有法律約束力。
column4: legally binding contract (有法律約束力的合約)
column5: bind 綁住，簽了字就像被繩子綁住不能反悔

column2: The signed contract will bind both companies for the next five years.
column3: 這份簽署的合約將在未來五年約束兩家公司。
column5: bind、find、mind 同押韻，bind 是用繩子綁住

column2: Wearing a helmet is obligatory on the construction site.
column3: 在工地戴安全帽是強制性的。
column5: obligate 負義務 + ory，規定非做不可的

column2: The agreement obligates the seller to repair any defects for a year.
column3: 該協議使賣方有義務在一年內修理任何瑕疵。
column4: obligate the buyer (使買方負義務)
column5: ob 向 + lig 綁，被一條繩子綁上了責任

column2: The supplier's failure to deliver was a breach of contract.
column3: 供應商未能交貨構成違約。
column5: beach 是海灘；breach 多一個 r，像堤防破了口

column2: Using customer data without permission would violate the company's privacy policy.
column3: 未經許可使用客戶資料會違反公司的隱私政策。
column5: violate 像 violet 紫色，違規被抓到臉都紫了

column2: The inspector fined the factory for a safety violation.
column3: 檢查員因一項安全違規而對工廠開罰。
column5: violate 的 e 換成 ion，名詞：違規這件事

column2: The shipping company is liable for any damage during transport.
column3: 運輸公司須為運送期間的任何損壞負責。
column4: liable for damages (須負賠償責任)
column5: liable 像「賴 bull」，想賴也賴不掉的責任

column2: The insurer will indemnify the client for losses caused by the fire.
column3: 保險公司將賠償客戶因火災造成的損失。
column5: 保險公司把損失補回來，讓你毫髮無傷

column2: The contract includes an indemnity clause covering legal costs.
column3: 合約包含一項涵蓋法律費用的賠償條款。
column5: indemnify 的名詞，ity 結尾，指補償金本身

column2: Both sides reached a settlement and avoided a long court case.
column3: 雙方達成和解，避免了冗長的訴訟。
column5: settle 安定下來 + ment，吵完坐定的結果

column2: The two firms agreed to settle the argument out of court.
column3: 兩家公司同意在庭外解決爭議。
column5: set 擺好 + tle，把吵鬧的事擺平，塵埃落定

column2: The two departments are in a dispute over who pays for the repairs.
column3: 兩個部門為了誰該付維修費而起爭執。
column5: dis 分開 + pute 想，想法分開就吵起來

column2: The disagreement went to arbitration instead of a courtroom.
column3: 這項歧見交付仲裁，而不是上法庭。
column5: 找一位中立的第三方當裁判，不必上法院

column2: A neutral lawyer was asked to arbitrate between the two companies.
column3: 一位中立的律師受邀在兩家公司之間進行仲裁。
column5: arbitration 去掉 ion 加 e，變動詞：當裁判

column2: The arbitrator ruled that the supplier must refund half the fee.
column3: 仲裁人裁定供應商必須退還一半的費用。
column5: arbitrate 加 or，就是吹哨判定的裁判員

column2: Employees must sign a confidentiality agreement before seeing the designs.
column3: 員工在看設計圖之前必須簽署保密協議。
column5: confidential 機密 + ity，把嘴巴拉上拉鍊的義務
column7: con - fi - den - ti - al - i - ty

column2: The law requires full disclosure of any risks to investors.
column3: 法律要求向投資人完整揭露任何風險。
column5: dis 打開 + closure 關閉，把關著的事打開講出來

column2: Staff may not disclose pricing details to competitors.
column3: 員工不得向競爭對手透露價格細節。
column5: dis 打開 + close 關，打開關著的門，秘密就跑出來

column2: The board approved an amendment to the original agreement.
column3: 董事會批准了對原協議的修正條款。
column4: an amendment to the contract (合約修正條款)
column5: amend 修正 + ment 名詞，修正後的新條文

column2: We need to amend the contract to include the new delivery date.
column3: 我們需要修訂合約，納入新的交貨日期。
column5: a 加 mend（補），把有問題的條文補好

column2: Please endorse the check on the back before depositing it.
column3: 存入之前，請在支票背面背書簽名。
column5: en 放上 + dorse 背部，簽在支票的背面

column2: Either party may request termination of the contract with thirty days' notice.
column3: 任何一方都可提前三十天通知，請求終止合約。
column5: terminal 是終點站，termination 就是合約到站下車

column2: Our service agreement will expire at the end of December.
column3: 我們的服務協議將在十二月底到期失效。
column5: ex 出 + pire 呼吸，最後一口氣吐出去就失效

column2: Check the expiration date on your passport before booking a flight.
column3: 訂機票前，請先檢查護照的到期日。
column5: expire 的名詞，就像食品包裝上的有效期限

column2: The renewal of our lease is due next week.
column3: 我們的租約續約手續下週就要辦理。
column5: re 再 + new 新，再換一份新的

column2: She called the landlord to renew her lease for another year.
column3: 她打電話給房東，要再續租一年。
column5: re 再 + new 新，舊約再新一次

column2: All suppliers must comply with the safety standards.
column3: 所有供應商都必須遵守安全標準。
column5: com 一起 + ply 照做，跟著規定一起走，常接 with

column2: The contract stipulates that payment is due within thirty days.
column3: 合約明文規定款項須在三十天內支付。
column5: 想像把條件一條條白紙黑字釘在紙上，不能改

column2: One stipulation of the loan is that the funds be used for equipment.
column3: 這筆貸款的一項約定條件是資金須用於購買設備。
column4: meet a stipulation (符合約定條件)
column5: stipulate 的名詞，白紙黑字寫下來的條件

column2: Jane took the minutes and emailed them to everyone after the meeting.
column3: 珍負責做會議記錄，並在會後寄給所有人。
column5: minute 是小的，把會議一分一秒的小細節記下來
